notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for ordinary attribute ownership-acquisition cancellation. The source uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, model FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies the standard pre-request and already-owned exception boundaries, a regular acquisition followed by cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition, the confirmAttributeOwnershipAcquisitionCancellation callback and its object/attribute metadata, absence of an acquisition notification, stable ownership, and rejection of a repeated cancellation. It does not assert provider-specific callback timing, MOM reports, DDM, timestamped delivery, save/restore, or interoperability.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador attributeOwnershipAcquisition and cancelAttributeOwnershipAcquisition with FederateAmbassador requestAttributeOwnershipRelease, confirmAttributeOwnershipAcquisitionCancellation, and attributeOwnershipAcquisitionNotification callbacks
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador ownership-management declarations
